# User Guide

polars-corpus is a Python/Rust extension for Polars that brings corpus linguistics workflows
into the DataFrame ecosystem. It is designed to handle large corpora (100M+ words) on
modest hardware without requiring external servers or databases.

## Sections

- [Installation](01-installation.qmd) — system requirements and setup
- [Data Format](02-data-format.qmd) — how corpora are structured as Parquet files
- [Concordancing](03-concordancing.qmd) — keyword-in-context search and KWIC output
- [Frequency Analysis](04-frequencies.qmd) — word and n-gram frequency counts
- [Collocations](05-collocations.qmd) — co-occurrence statistics and association measures
- [Query Languages](query/index.qmd) — Simple and CQP query syntax reference
